meta.name: design-taste-frontend-v1
meta.description: The original v1 taste-skill, preserved for projects depending on its exact behavior. The current default is `design-taste-frontend` (v2 experimental), which is a substantial rewrite. Use this v1 install name only if you need exact backward compatibility.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保留旧版设计品味，确保前端项目兼容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目依赖旧版设计品味技能的行为
copy.tagline_en: Preserve legacy design taste for frontend compatibility
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project depends on the exact behavior of the v1 design taste skill

howto.what: 写前端界面时按一套固定审美规则生成 React/Next.js + Tailwind 代码:先查 package.json 再装依赖,禁用 emoji、Inter 字体、紫色霓虹和居中大标题,并要求补上加载、空、错误状态。
howto.when: 当你要做前端界面或页面(React、Next.js 等)时接管;只有在需要与 v1 完全向后兼容时才用这个安装名,当前默认是 v2。

say.text: 帮我做一个产品落地页,用这套审美规则
say.note: 会先查 package.json 缺哪些依赖

say.text: 把 DESIGN_VARIANCE 调到 9,做一个不对称首页
say.note: 窄屏会自动回退成单列布局

say.text: 这个仪表盘用 VISUAL_DENSITY 8 重做,不要卡片
say.note: 数据改用 1px 分隔线和等宽字体

howto.what_en: When writing frontend UI it produces React/Next.js + Tailwind code under fixed taste rules: checks package.json before adding dependencies, bans emoji, Inter font, purple neon and centered heroes, and adds loading/empty/error states.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you build frontend pages in React or Next.js; use this v1 install name only if you need exact backward compatibility, since the default is v2.

say_en.text: Build me a product landing page using these taste rules
say_en.note: It checks package.json for missing deps

say_en.text: Set DESIGN_VARIANCE to 9 and make an asymmetric homepage
say_en.note: Falls back to one column on narrow screens

say_en.text: Redo this dashboard with VISUAL_DENSITY 8, no cards
say_en.note: Data uses 1px lines and mono type
